description: Use this to open and cite an EU legislative provision found by search. Simple retrieval of one provision's text by its cite anchor id (e.g. "psd-2 Art 97"), with citation metadata. A provision longer than the response ceiling arrives in part, with metadata.complete false and a metadata.next_cursor that get_provision continues. Accepts only ids this service minted — free-text citations belong to resolve_citation. get_provision returns more: paging, applicability and typed warnings.

id.description: An id from search, or a cite anchor such as "psd-2 Art 97" or "psd-2 Recital 12", or an instrument id such as "psd-2". An optional version qualifier, e.g. "psr (com-2023-367) Art 105", retains its edition and refuses unserved text.

name: fetch

cites.description: What the returned text cites in other acts, in source order, one entry per target. phrase is the text's own wording before the citation. outcome says what this service can open: served (open returns the cited provision), parent_served (open returns a parent; find cited_limb in it), act_only (the text names only the act; get_instrument shows coverage, not what any article says), not_served or not_held (nothing here opens it; check it at source_url or the official text), or unresolved. Open a target when its wording could change the answer. An empty list means no citation was extracted from this text, not that nothing outside this corpus is relevant.

pointers_omitted.description: Entries left out of cites and terms_used by the size limit. Request a paragraph or point to see them.

refers_to.description: References in the returned text to a paragraph, or to a Part, Title, Chapter, Section or Subsection, that this service could establish exactly. words is the text as printed. Each target is a paragraph or article, with its cite and the get_provision call that opens it, or a level, with its name, its heading where the act gives one, and its first and last article, each with its call. Words naming several paragraphs list every target. A reference in the text that is not listed here was not established; that is not evidence about what it refers to.

refers_to_omitted.description: Entries left out of refers_to by the size limit. Request a paragraph to see them.

complete.description: All notes referenced in this response's text, not the whole document or later pages.

source_notes.description: Null means unverified/unsupported coverage or an older release; consult the typed warning. Not an empty note inventory. Legal content_hash and block counts exclude this attachment. The verified note scope is DMD articles and recitals. Introductory citations are not an MCP provision kind: their notes remain on the website's reading pages, not attached to articles.

terms_used.description: The instrument's own defined terms in the returned text that lead somewhere, each with its definition's cite. leads_to lists the provisions the definition refers to, already followed. includes lists categories defined as kinds of this term, and kind_of the categories this term is a kind of, so a provision that applies to those applies to it too; both are read from the definitions, nearest first. An entry with a condition is a category made by a scope article, and the link holds only when the condition, quoted from its cite, is met; for names which of the term's categories an entry concerns. A term absent here may still be defined: get_defined_term returns any definition.

text.description: The legal text selected from the provision. Full referenced note bodies travel separately in metadata.source_notes; notes do not alter legal block counts or content_hash.

title: Read EU legislative text (compatible)
